Climb into the cockpit of early jet fighters and shape the outcome of legendary aerial battles. Korea. IL-2 Series takes you to a pivotal moment in aviation history—a time when jet engines changed the skies forever. During the Korean War, the piston-engine aircraft of a bygone era clashed with the first jet fighters. For the first time in the series, gamepads are supported in addition to joysticks and HOTAS control systems. With a massive combat map, authentically recreated aircraft, and a well-crafted balance between simulation and accessibility, every dogfight is brought to life. Become an ace, fight in legendary machines, or aim even higher and become a regiment’s commander. Lead squadrons, plot routes across the combat map, and issue orders to turn the tide of history. In the skies of Korea, you can be anyone: from a rank-and-file pilot to a strategist shaping the outcome of the campaign. For the first time in the IL-2 series, full controller support has been implemented. The aircraft of the Korean War have been recreated based on actual blueprints, historical photographs, flight manuals, and other archival materials. There are eight aircraft at your disposal. Every instrument in the cockpit is fully functional and reflects the state of the aircraft’s systems in real time. You will be aiming and firing just as pilots did 75 years ago. The game takes place on the largest map in the series' history, covering an area of over 200,000 square kilometers. The Korean Peninsula has been recreated based on historical maps and documents from the 1950s. All significant historical landscape changes have been accounted for, including reclaimed coastal areas and shoreline changes. The map features dozens of airbases with historically accurate layouts, hundreds of settlements, and strategic objectives such as ports, dams, and transport hubs. In Career mode, you will act as an air regiment commander, managing personnel and overseeing aviation logistics. It is up to you to decide whether to take to the skies or focus on strategic tasks. As a regiment commander, you will maintain combat readiness, plan operations, and reinforce your units. Korea features a highly detailed damage model for both aviation and ground objects. Aircraft, including strategic bombers, as well as ground vehicles, trains, and ships, receive damage corresponding to the nature of the hits sustained. Every object reacts realistically to collisions, crashes, and combat damage, taking into account mass, speed, and the point of impact, directly affecting the behavior of the vehicle and the outcome of the battle. In this new mode, you can examine each aircraft, ground vehicle, and naval vessel in detail. Explore the models, learn about their development and combat history, inspect aircraft cockpits, and compare technical specs, including detailed performance charts. Your own personal museum, open anytime—a true treasure for anyone passionate about aviation and military history. For the first time in the series, you can leave the cockpit and walk around the airfield where your regiment is based. Animations of the people—pilots, soldiers, and civilians—were created using motion capture (MOCAP) technology, ensuring natural and lifelike movement. Designed for full immersion: Full VR support via OpenXR and OpenVR. Accessibility: The game features detailed systems management, but there’s no need to memorize engine start-up sequences—you can take off and engage immediately. The main inspirations come from Neo Scavenger, Gates of Hell, RimWorld. The story background is inspired by pivotal conflicts in modern history. You will take on the role of the only surviving officer in the company after an enemy airstrike, taking up the responsibility in a crisis, gathering the remnants, and leading the troops through battle after battle to break through the dilemma, gradually growing into an elite force. Gameplay Design It’s more important to play a bad hand well than to be dealt a good one. Through the high-altitude drone combat command platform, you cannot participate in combat personally, but you can observe the real-time situation on the battlefield and quickly update your combat deployments via the drone’s camera. However, there is still a time gap and human factors in the issuing and execution of orders. Sometimes, you must anticipate in advance or radically shift your approach. But plans never keep up with changes — perhaps you should be prepared for your operations to be disrupted. Frontline Logistics: Isarian Warfare is dedicated to expressing aspects rarely touched upon by other war games: Detailed classification of logistics work. Machine gun ammo belts must be assembled from loose rounds in the ammo workshop before they can be used by gunners; ingredients are cooked into hot meals in the field kitchen; the severely wounded undergo emergency surgery before being transported to the rear for treatment; fallen comrades are recovered, prepared, and sent back. Customizable armament. In war, the only constant is “change”, and that applies to machines too. Not every piece of armament can function like it came out of the factory. When there are no suitable replacement parts, or when you have two tanks each with different damages, “working” is the only requirement — if it can be fixed, it must not be scrapped! In addition, you can also modify your armament to add new functions to suit different battlefield environments. Soldiers who obey orders but retain individuality. Your soldiers execute combat orders strictly, but may also pick up loot amid the hail of bullets. Besides ammunition, their backpacks may also carry “junk” they can’t bear to discard — if deployed near a river, they might even bring back a big fish for the mess hall in the evening. Balanced nutrition, properly rationed. Frontline Logistics: Isarian Warfare strongly encourages players to enhance the frontline living conditions of their troops in every possible way — and rations are a key part of that. In the game, you can recreate real-world rationing systems used across various theaters of war: rear-echelon logistics personnel receive standard provisions, while frontline combat units are kept well-fed and ready for action. If managing such details isn't your style, this aspect won’t penalize you or block your progress in combat operations. However, better-fed soldiers will fight more effectively and exhibit greater resistance to injuries and illness. *Plenty of protein makes soldiers stronger, vitamins help them fight off infections, a small snack adds a touch of dignity to dinner, and a drink can make even the blandest meal easier to swallow. Battlefield rescue — time is life. Frontline Logistics: Isarian Warfare provides a detailed and smooth battlefield rescue experience. From emergency treatment on the field to the transfer of the wounded, to surgery at the aid point and medical evacuation — you need to quickly judge based on the situation: whether to risk using helicopters to evacuate from the combat zone, or play it safe and use armored vehicles for transport. Having the medical team accompany can also buy more time for the wounded. Although survival ultimately depends on fate, rest assured — Frontline Logistics: Isarian Warfare will not let your efforts go to waste. Game events with unique perspectives. Receive frontline journalists for interviews. As long as their safety is ensured, the closer they are to the front, the more valuable footage they can get — and the greater the rewards you’ll receive. Frontline Logistics: Isarian Warfare is a game that tells a war story unique to you. Every action of each soldier under your command will be recorded. Even those who die heroically will be remembered by history. You can set a time range, and the system will automatically collect the combat records of troops during that period and compile them into a battle report, restoring your command orders through text. You can personally name each operation — yes, you are also a part of history. Visual Design In addition to gameplay design, Frontline Logistics: Isarian Warfare has gone to great lengths to enhance immersion through its visual design. Unit Icons The game's unit icons are based on real-world NATO military symbols. When a unit's equipment changes, the icon automatically updates to reflect its current configuration, accurately representing real-world military notation. You can freely customize different unit types to your liking. (Example: When a recon squad boards a pickup truck, its unit icon will change to that of a motorized recon squad.) Destructible Structures In Frontline Logistics: Isarian Warfare , buildings are composed of modular rooms that react dynamically to player actions. You're on duty in the underground bunker of Area 51, where the most dangerous part begins at the elevator: the shaft descends for miles down to unknown levels. Whether it's laboratories, anomalies, inhumane experiments, or something alien—you're not supposed to know. Your task is simple: let in those who have access and stop those who don't... even if everything looks "right" on the surface. SECURE, CONTAIN, PROTECT Everyone who passes through your checkpoint carries papers, passes, or verbal orders. Your job is to check names, positions, clearance levels, and time, ensuring the number of people entering and leaving matches, and pay attention to any oddities. These could be incorrect answers, behavior that deviates from protocol, slurred speech, or even documents that seem too perfect. Some decisions will have immediate consequences, others only after several shifts. CONTAIN THE THREAT The consequences of every mistake go far beyond issues in the workplace. Let the wrong person out, and the infection will ravage the city. Isolate suspicious employees, investigate anomalies, and launch new operations to contain the threat before it's too late. evidence.chinaDemandEvidence: Wardwell is a Chinese folklore-inspired idle management game. As the ancient well calls, waters surge beneath the earth and omens warn of the Drought Demon’s return. Restore the shrine, manage incense, welcome worshippers, and uncover the mystery buried below. The ancient well is calling, and the waters beneath the earth are beginning to surge. Cracked soil and unnatural moisture spread through the village at the same time. Every omen points toward an old and forbidden legend: the Drought Demon is about to awaken. To keep the disturbances from spreading, you must take charge of the abandoned ritual grounds surrounding the well. Clear away burnt incense, rebuild the shrine, welcome returning worshippers, and gather the resources needed to investigate each new call from below. Wardwell is an idle management game inspired by Chinese folklore and supernatural tales. There is no high-pressure real-time combat. Instead, you will manage the shrine, plan your resources, and unlock new paths of progression as ominous events unfold around the ancient well. The Well Calls, and the Omens Draw Near The ancient well will not remain silent. As time passes, supernatural events progress through charging, warning, manifestation, and resolution stages. Water surging beneath the earth, gathering spiritual energy, and signs of the Drought Demon’s return gradually appear through environmental changes and event sequences. Wandering spirits, jiangshi, and water ghosts may also emerge alongside the well’s disturbances, leaving behind strange tales and unusual materials. Every event is both an omen and an opportunity to learn more about the well, unlock new developments, and reveal what lies ahead. These events are not conventional real-time battles. Your accumulated resources, unlocked content, and the development of the shrine determine how prepared you are for the intensifying disturbances. Build an Economy from Burnt Incense Burnt incense continuously accumulates around the shrine. At first, every piece must be cleared by hand. As your operation develops, you can unlock brooms for batch clearing and Clean Wind Talismans that automatically remove burnt incense over time. Restoring the small incense burner increases the amount produced during each cycle while also providing a steady source of incense income. Clear the remains, gather incense, invest in upgrades, and unlock new ways to make the cycle increasingly efficient. Restore the Abandoned Shrine Spend incense to restore the small incense burner, offering stone, wish rack, and merit box. Each facility has its own method of production and can affect both worshipper offerings and the shrine’s overall income. What begins as slow manual collection can gradually develop into a growing system of batch processing, continuous production, and automation. How you invest your limited incense determines whether you pursue immediate gains or save resources for future events and progression nodes. Welcome Visiting Worshippers Worshippers travel along the village roads to reach the shrine, stopping at different facilities before making their offerings. Each visitor has their own fortune, which can influence both the journey and the result of the offering. Improve facilities and traditions to increase the value of their visits. Observe the flow of worshippers and plan your development so that their offerings become a stable part of the shrine’s economy. Their arrival is also a sign that the villagers still believe the restored shrine can withstand the omens gathering around the well. Place Wards to Strengthen Production Paper talismans, bronze bells, and well stones are part of the shrine’s management system. Once unlocked, they can be placed at designated locations to improve incense generation, facility output, or other resources. Each ward offers a different production benefit and requires its own investment. Choosing which wards to prioritize allows you to shape the shrine’s economy around the resources you need most. Wards do not participate in real-time combat or directly intercept supernatural entities. Their purpose is to strengthen your resource cycle and create more room for long-term development. Choose Your Path through an Interconnected Progression Tree Facilities, traditions, wards, and strange tales form a single interconnected progression tree. Focus on increasing incense production and burnt-incense clearing, improve the offerings made by worshippers, unlock new production wards, or invest in tales connected to the disturbances of the well. Unusual materials obtained from supernatural events—including jiangshi fangs, broken corpse bells, and black glutinous rice—can unlock further nodes. Management provides the resources needed to investigate the omens, while each new event brings additional materials, stories, and paths of progression.
